title: AI Story & Edit Planning
scope: Reuse existing CAIP story-builder and edit-timeline persistence authorities instead of creating a competing story/edit model
Require one confirmed Build 46 synchronization group with exactly four confirmed camera tracks before Build 47 planning can run
Consume only active approved source-backed temporal evidence from confirmed camera tracks in the selected Build 46 group
Exclude rejected or purge-requested media and rejected footage-quality records from story/edit planning
Rank reviewed evidence deterministically from category, source confidence, footage quality, semantic approval and transcript coverage
Generate a source-linked story draft with retained evidence IDs and script/story beat text
Require explicit human story review or approval before edit-plan generation
Generate an editable source-linked timeline carrying source in/out points, camera labels, captions and confirmed synchronization offsets
Revalidate every story beat and edit clip against current approved evidence before saving reviewed changes
Return fresh authoritative story/edit read-back after every mutation
Show target-duration overflow rather than silently dropping approved story beats
Keep external AI/LLM provider execution, media rendering, publication, R2 mutation and raw public R2 URLs disabled
Add forward Current Application Quality and syntax protection for the Build 47 boundary
build45_dependency: Build 47 uses reviewed Build 45 source-backed media intelligence and approved temporal/transcript evidence only.
build46_dependency: Build 47 requires a confirmed Build 46 group with exactly four confirmed cameras and all included synchronization tracks confirmed.
build48_boundary: Build 48 remains the next bounded Grey Hair CAIP automation continuation and may begin only after Build 47 authority closure independently proves GREEN. Build 47 itself performs no external AI/provider execution, media rendering, publication or R2 mutation.
external_lanes: CAIP private-media HOLD unless fresh authenticated runtime evidence proves acceptance
next_build_rule: Begin only after the Build 47 authority-only descendant independently passes System Gate, Current Application Quality, I.T. Admin Runtime Proof and Repository Branch Hygiene on its exact merged dev SHA.
